name: keypad-entry
prompt: Build a door-code entry panel: a 4x4 matrix keypad and a piezo buzzer for key clicks on an Arduino Uno, with the buzzer driven through an NPN transistor with a base resistor.
notes: Eight matrix lines to eight distinct digital pins plus a driver stage. The keypad rows/columns must land on eight different pins — shorting two onto one pin passes a naive count but fails the accuracy checker's distinctness test.
